onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset).

choice.npy.Description: which choice was made in choiceworld: -1 (turn CCW), +1 (turn CW), or 0 (nogo)

contrastLeft.npy.Description: contrast of left-side stimulus (0...1) nan if trial is on other side

contrastRight.npy.Description: contrast of right-side stimulus (0...1) nan if trial is on other side

feedbackType.npy.Description: Whether feedback is positive or negative in choiceworld (-1 for negative, +1 for positive)

feedback_times.npy.Description: Times of stimulus onset trigger command

firstMovement_times.npy.Description: Times of stimulus onset trigger command

goCueTrigger_times.npy.Description: Times of stimulus onset trigger command

goCue_times.npy.Description: Times of stimulus onset trigger command

intervals_bpod.npy.Description: 2 column array giving each trials start (i.e. beginning of quiescent period) and stop (i.e. end of iti) times of trials in universal seconds

probabilityLeft.npy.Description: Probability of stimulation to be turned on within the trial

response_times.npy.Description: Times of stimulus onset trigger command

rewardVolume.npy.Description: volume of reward given each trial in µl

stimOff_times.npy.Description: Times of stimulus onset trigger command

stimOn_times.npy.Description: Times of stimulus onset trigger command

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
Levels.BehavioralEpochs: The 'BehavioralEpochs' table in the NWB file.
